starters.title: Create an avatar
starters.description: Give me a bit more personality, and see how chat and image-making work.
starters.prompt: I'd like to create an avatar for you. Ask me what you should look like, then make a few options as images and save them as assets so I can pick one. When I've picked, set it as your avatar. If you can't make images here yet, tell me what needs setting up first.

starters.title: Create an image
starters.description: Describe what you want and I'll make a few options.
starters.prompt: I'd like you to create an image for me. Ask me what I have in mind, then make it. If you can't make images here yet, tell me what needs setting up first.

starters.title: Schedule a reminder
starters.description: Tell me once and I'll nudge you when it matters.
starters.prompt: I'd like to set a reminder. Ask me what it's for and when, then schedule it.

starters.title: Research a topic
starters.description: Name a subject and I'll come back with a brief and sources.
starters.prompt: I'd like you to research a topic for me and write up what you find, with sources. Ask me what the topic is. If you can't search the web here yet, tell me what needs setting up first.

starters.title: Break a goal into tasks
starters.description: Say what you're trying to get done and I'll put it on the board.
starters.prompt: I have a goal I'd like to break down into tasks on the board. Ask me what it is, then create the tasks.

personalities.label: Charming
personalities.sample: Nice, that's a solid start. Want me to draft the next part while you look this over?
personalities.soul: You are warm, encouraging and patient. You notice what is going well before what needs fixing, and you offer the next step instead of waiting to be asked. You never talk down to anyone, and you keep explanations short and kind.

personalities.label: Brutally efficient
personalities.sample: Done. Three issues found; the second one blocks launch. Fix list attached.
personalities.soul: You are direct and efficient. You lead with the answer, then the one or two things that matter most. You skip pleasantries and filler, say plainly when something is wrong, and keep everything as short as it can be while staying complete.

personalities.label: A little sarcastic
personalities.sample: Good news: it works. Bad news: nobody knows why. I've written down my best guess.
personalities.soul: You have a dry sense of humor and you use it sparingly: one light line, never at the expense of the answer or the person. Under the wit you are precise and reliable. When something is serious, you drop the jokes entirely.

personalities.label: Cool, calm, collected
personalities.sample: There are two ways to do this. Here's what each one costs you, and the one I'd pick.
personalities.soul: You are calm and thoughtful. You lay out the real options, what each one costs, and which you would choose and why. You do not rush, you do not overstate, and you say so when you are not sure.

suggestions.title: Let your agents search the web
suggestions.payoff: Research with current facts and sources, not only what the model remembers.

suggestions.title: Finish setting up web search
suggestions.payoff: It is installed and one key away from working.

suggestions.title: Create and edit images
suggestions.payoff: Add a key for an image provider and your agents can make pictures from a description.

suggestions.title: Add a specialist to your team
suggestions.payoff: A researcher, a developer or an image artist your main agent can hand work to.

suggestions.title: Hear from your agents in Discord
suggestions.payoff: Get alerts and approve work from a channel, without opening Bakin.

suggestions.title: Plan bigger work as a project
suggestions.payoff: Keep a spec, its checklist and its tasks in one place your agents can read.

tour.title: Chat
tour.body: Talk to any agent the way you would message a colleague. Attach a file, ask a follow-up, or come back to an old conversation; everything is kept and searchable.
tour.first: Ask your main agent what it can help with this week.

tour.title: Tasks
tour.body: The board is where work lives once it is more than a conversation. Agents pick tasks up, report progress as they go, and hand them back for your review.
tour.first: Ask an agent to break a goal into tasks, then watch the board.

tour.title: Team
tour.body: Every agent has a name, a personality and things it is good at. Team is where you meet them, change how they come across, and add specialists.
tour.first: Open your main agent and read how it describes itself.

tour.title: Assets
tour.body: Anything an agent makes for you, a document, an image or a report, is saved here with its earlier versions. Nothing is lost in a chat scroll.
tour.first: Ask for a draft, then find it here.

tour.title: Schedule
tour.body: Work that should happen without you asking: a briefing every morning, a report every Friday. The calendar shows what is coming and what already ran.
tour.first: Ask an agent to set up a daily briefing.

tour.title: Health
tour.body: Bakin watches itself. When something needs attention, Health says what is wrong in plain words and usually offers to fix it for you.
tour.first: Look here first whenever something seems off.

pageIntroductions.title: Meet your new coworkers.
pageIntroductions.body: Chat is where you work with your agents. Pick one and ask for anything; every conversation is kept.

pageIntroductions.title: This is where the work lives.
pageIntroductions.body: Agents pick tasks up, move them across the board, and hand them back when they need you.

pageIntroductions.title: Everyone on your team, in one place.
pageIntroductions.body: See who does what, change how an agent comes across, or bring in a specialist.

pageIntroductions.title: Nothing your agents make gets lost.
pageIntroductions.body: Documents, images and reports land here with their earlier versions, ready to find again.

pageIntroductions.title: Work that happens while you're away.
pageIntroductions.body: Briefings, reports, reminders: anything on a schedule shows up here, with what ran and what's next.

pageIntroductions.title: Bakin keeps an eye on itself.
pageIntroductions.body: If something needs attention it shows up here in plain words, usually with a fix. Quiet means all is well.
